KL-000.stateNote: adversarial-passed under protocols v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.2.0. Cross-implementation conformance of the EVALUATOR and the CONCLUSION FUNCTION is now established: IND-20260807-2 reproduced the exhaustive conclusion distribution exactly (present 41,820 / supported 19,380 / not_established 49,480 / absent 160), closing the 22,440-world divergence; qualified by the commission-package leak recorded in results/independent/PROVENANCE-IND-20260807-2.md, with both mitigations verified. committedGates.statement: the independent implementation re-runs against protocol v1.2.0 and attempts C11/C12; see nextGate for the exact pass condition

Register and implement I12: conclusion == conclusionFunction(world), as a hard invariant subsuming I2's and I5's conclusion clauses. COMMITTED GATE, not a candidate -- promoted by owner direction during RUN-20260807-3's close: RESEARCH-METHOD.md and the program's success definition require an exact next falsifiable gate, and G4 is the strongest open finding in the kernel; recording it as a candidate would let it lapse without anyone deciding to drop it.
committedGates.evidence: Verified this run against the full enumeration (logs/g4-inverted-r1-ablation.txt, RUN-20260807-3): an evaluator inverting R1 (the existential presence reading) changes 22,440 of 110,840 conclusions, violates ZERO of the eleven hard invariants, and is caught by fixture C11 alone -- one input out of 176,120. I12 would catch the same inversion on all 22,440 divergent worlds across the entire enumeration with no fixture involved.
committedGates.exactPassCondition: The existential-reading ablation is caught by I12 on exactly 22,440 exhaustive worlds; B5 records zero I12 violations; no other number moves.
committedGates.sequencing: Deferred behind IND-20260807-3 deliberately -- mixing a new invariant into the serialisation-only v1.2.0 repair would have destroyed the did-evaluation-move test that made v1.2.0 verifiable, and the commission target stays frozen while the implementer works. Deferred is not optional: this gate is committed and its lapse would itself be a recordable event.
